name: m11-w3-dry2
note: Dry check 2 after the fixed-evidence rules were added to both document prompts. Four instances spanning LABEL, COMPARISON, NUMERIC and USER, both arms, **unrecorded**. Its job is to see whether the rules move the arms off zero, and whether the answer form is now obeyed. Two of the four are the same instances as dry check 1, so the comparison is pairwise.

arms.name: a0-doc
arms.note: A0-doc: the whole document in one prompt, one call. No loop, no tools.

arms.name: a2-doc
arms.note: A2-doc: REPL over the same file. Sub-calls are 0 because the document prompt advertises no sub-task and sub_extract hydrates ids from the database, so the route would be a capability the run cannot use. The final gate and the claim pass are skipped in document mode and the skip is logged.
